deadline.value: Priority deadline February 15, 2027 for Fall 2027 PhD admission (applications evaluated rolling thereafter; final Fall deadline May 1 per CCNY).
deadline.quote: Below you will find the information required to apply for the Fall 2027 admission cycle. | Priority Deadline: February 15, 2027

gre_general.value: The ME PhD program page states the GRE requirement is suspended and scores will not be considered (note: an older CCNY admissions summary still lists GRE Required: Yes).
gre_general.quote: The GRE requirement is suspended for the Fall 2026 application cycle. Please do not send GRE scores, as they will not be considered in the application review process.

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for Mechanical Engineering (ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

toefl_min.value: CCNY's Mechanical Engineering admissions page lists minimum TOEFL 73 iBT (533 PBT).

supervisor.value: Prospective students are strongly encouraged to contact faculty members to inquire about lab openings.
supervisor.quote: We strongly encourage prospective students to contact the faculty members they are interested in working with to inquire about potential openings in their research labs.

funding.value: All admitted ME PhD students are offered full financial support (stipend and tuition waiver) via RA and/or TA appointments.
funding.quote: All students admitted to our Ph.D. program will be offered full financial support, which includes a stipend and tuition waiver, through a Research Assistantship and/or a Teaching Assistantship.

entry_route.value: Open to applicants holding an accredited bachelor's degree (or foreign equivalent) with an adequate ME/engineering background.
entry_route.quote: Graduate study is open to qualified students who possess a bachelor’s degree from an accredited U.S. college or university or the equivalent from a foreign institution and an adequate background in the field of study that they wish to pursue.

notes: The older CCNY Admissions summary for Mechanical Engineering lists GRE Required: Yes and IELTS 6, whereas the active ME Graduate Program page (updated for Fall 2027) suspends GRE and CCNY graduate admissions FAQ lists IELTS 6.5 as the college baseline.
name: Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering
